title: feat(setup): retire Packaged automation's flows half; Packaged actions is its own Setup entry
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbB5em8iozkeVyx4gPsLp6Qf)_

Part of #28578

PR 1 of 2. Wanted 1, 2, 4 and 5 (Setup's metadata pages into Studio's All metadata area) follow in a second PR on this branch, after this one merges. That PR closes the card. The split keeps each PR under the 3000-line human-merge threshold (claim amendment 6561871570).

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：设置 › 打包自动化页面的"流程"一半下线（ADR-0146 D11）。导航项 `nav_packaged_automation`（`automation:packaged`）换成 `nav_packaged_actions`（"Packaged Actions"，`automation:packaged-actions`），页面只保留打包动作的开关列表。Studio 不再链接到这个下线的页面。
- **为什么改**：ADR-0146 D4 已把打包流程的开关和"新建类似"放进 Studio 的自动化栏。设置里的流程页已经重复，D11 判定下线。
- **风险与回滚**：风险低。旧页面的流程开关和克隆在 Studio 里都有对应入口。旧 URL `/apps/setup/component/automation/packaged` 不再对应任何页面。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup-nav.contributions.ts`、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/PackagedActionsPage.tsx`、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/services/builtinComponents.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**：打开设置，"应用"分组里应该看到"Packaged Actions"，点开只有动作开关。打开 Studio › 组织流程（`/studio/~org/automations`），空状态不再链接到设置。
- **需要你做的**：无。

## What changes

- **Setup navigation** (`@objectstack/platform-objects`). `nav_packaged_automation` is replaced by `{ id: 'nav_packaged_actions', type: 'component', label: 'Packaged Actions', componentRef: 'automation:packaged-actions', icon: 'zap' }`, in `group_apps` beside Packages. Like the old entry it has no `requiresService` and no `requiredPermissions`. The label is in en, zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES, with the source-hash rows moved. `nav_packaged_automation` joins the dead-key tombstone.
- **The page** (`@object-ui/app-shell`). The new `PackagedActionsPage` is a page header plus `PackagedActionsSection` (`headed={false}`). `builtinComponents` registers it as `automation:packaged-actions` and no longer registers `automation:packaged`. `PackagedAutomationPage.tsx` and its test are removed, and the `index.ts` export becomes `PackagedActionsPage`. The shared helpers `packagedFlows.ts`, `packagedFlowLedger.ts` and `packagedActions.ts` stay; Studio uses them.
- **Studio stops linking to the retired page.** The Organization flows empty state reads "No flows outside a package. To change a packaged flow, open its package and use New similar." and has no action. The en and zh keys are reworded, and `engine.studio.org.openSetup` is removed from the Studio namespace. `BuilderLanding` drops `packagedAutomationPath`.
- **Platform checklist.** The one citation in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/automation.json` that named `setup-nav.contributions.ts#nav_packaged_automation` now names `#nav_packaged_actions`. Claim amendment 6561766478 added this to the surface, and `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` reported it as a LOST anchor until it was re-pointed.

## Why

ADR-0146 D4 put a packaged flow's on/off switch and its copy (New similar) into Studio's Automations pillar. D11 retires the Setup page that duplicated them. Setup keeps the operational state for packaged actions, which has no Studio home.

## Tests

- `setup-packaged-actions-nav.test.ts` (renamed from `setup-packaged-automation-nav.test.ts`) pins the new entry: its ref, group, no gates, and that it parses. It also pins the retired id and ref staying absent.
- `setup-nav-dead-key-tombstone.test.ts` gains `nav_packaged_automation`.
- `PackagedActionsPage.navContribution.test.tsx` (renamed) checks that the ref resolves with `@object-ui/app-shell` as source and `automation/packaged-actions` as segments, that the page mounts through `ComponentNavView` with one "Packaged actions" heading, and that `automation:packaged` resolves to nothing.
- New `noRetiredSetupLink-28578.test.ts` reads every Studio source with comments masked and refuses `automation:packaged` and `automation/packaged`. It also has a matcher control. Run against the `272fec05` copies of `BuilderLanding.tsx`, the pattern catches the base's `automation:packaged`.
- `StudioDesignSurface.homeLoop-12513`, `StudioDesignSurface.packageLessFlows-11553` and `BuilderLanding.setupExit-12513` are updated to the new empty state and the missing route builder.

## Verification

Base `272fec05`.

- `@objectstack/platform-objects`: `vitest run src/apps` gave 37 files and 578 tests green. `typecheck` is green.
- ui: 146 test files under the verify lock (`--maxWorkers=2`), 1772 tests green after one stale string was fixed. The set is narrowed to every app-shell and console test that names the touched modules (`PackagedActions`, `packagedFlows`, `builtinComponents`, `BuilderLanding`, `auto-empty`, `engine.studio.org.`, `~org`, `automation:packaged`), plus all of `packages/i18n`. The full app-shell suite is left to CI's Test UI shards.
- Type-check: `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/console` and `@object-ui/i18n` are green.
- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main`: 0 lost.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 68 commands. 65 exited 0, including `check-sdui-manifest`, `check:platform-checklist`, `check:nul-bytes` and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (171 files). `check:i18n` exited 3 for a prerequisite, and after the prerequisite build it is green: all 10 packages' bundles are in sync. Two are left to CI because their prerequisites are not met here: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needs a whole-workspace build, and `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needs an unshallow clone.
- PR-body gates on this body: `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-closing-keyword-parity` and `check-partof-closing-keyword` are green.
